title: Master Switch
doc: One key. Off runs the game unmodified without removing the plugin, which
is the first thing to check when the mod appears to do nothing: Run53 was
a whole session spent discovering this was false (AGENTS.md section 6).
ORDER MATTERS in Plugin.Load(). The bail-out sits above every subsystem
init. It used to sit underneath, which meant Enabled = false still let
ModelRules rewrite every row and PowerLevelCap overwrite every calculation
- the switch turned off the difficulty knobs and nothing else.
uiDoc: The master switch for the whole mod.
Off runs the game unmodified, with the plugin still installed. Nothing on any other page has any effect while this is off, whatever that page is set to.

fields.label: Enable CKF Hard Mode
fields.doc: Turn off to run the game unmodified without removing the plugin.
